name: focus-pull
title: Focus Pull
description: A rack focus between scenes: the outgoing scene defocuses and brightens, the incoming scene pulls into sharp focus. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .fcp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A calm, cinematic scene change that mimics a camera rack focus.
Moving between two ideas of equal weight without a hard cut.
avoidWhen: You need a fast, punchy cut: use push-through or zoom-blur.
The outgoing scene must stay legible until the last frame.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Peak blur of the defocused scene.
